note: The loop walks the attacker-supplied TLVs without validating that each TLV's declared length fits within the buffer.

A CommissionerSessionId TLV with a truncated length is cast to CommissionerSessionIdTlv and GetCommissionerSessionId() reads 2 bytes at cur+2 without checking the TLV length, performing an out-of-bounds read past the end of the tlvs buffer.

The 2-byte mSessionId field is read from a malformed TLV whose declared length is smaller than 2, so the read extends beyond the valid TLV value and past the stack buffer, triggering the memory-safety violation.
